description: This Java class defines an immutable data transfer object representing different loan status enumeration values, along with a nested MapStruct mapper interface for converting a Loan domain object to LoanStatusEnumData.

classes.name: LoanStatusEnumData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing loan status enumerations.

classes.name: LoanStatusEnumData.Mapper
classes.description: MapStruct mapper interface for converting Loan objects to LoanStatusEnumData instances.

methods.name: LoanStatusEnumData
methods.description: Constructor initializing LoanStatusEnumData with specific status ID, code, and value, and setting boolean flags based on the ID.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Default mapping method in Mapper interface to map a Loan object to LoanStatusEnumData via LoanEnumerations.status().
